verdict.rationale: Consensus documents a built-in research agent that chains citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search and similar-paper discovery. It also offers conversational Threads and Deep Search, which runs literature reviews in minutes, so users can hand off multi-step research tasks inside the product. All of this comes from short first-party marketing taglines, with little detail on what can be delegated or how the agent executes. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the agent's task scope, autonomy and controls, delegation beyond literature search and synthesis, and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Consensus has evolved from a search tool into a research agent. Citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search, similar papers, and more - chained together on top of the worlds best academic search engine.
Introducing: Consensus Deep Search 🔬 Literature Reviews in Minutes.
Threads reimagines how you interact with peer-reviewed research by turning isolated searches into flowing conversations.
Search, screen, extract, and synthesize evidence faster—while keeping full transparency and scholarly rigor.
